items.source: Indicates that method-level @Sql declarations should be merged with class-level @Sql declarations, with class-level SQL scripts and statements executed before method-level scripts and statements.
items.translation: 指示将方法级别的 `@Sql` 声明与类级别的 `@Sql` 声明合并，且类级别的 SQL 脚本和语句在执行顺序上先于方法级别的脚本和语句。

items.source: Indicates that method-level @Sql declarations should override class-level @Sql declarations.
items.translation: 指示方法级别的@Sql声明应覆盖类级别的@Sql声明。

items.source: Enumeration of modes that dictate whether method-level @Sql declarations are merged with class-level @Sql declarations.
items.translation: 枚举模式，用于规定是否将方法级别的@Sql声明与类级别的@Sql声明合并。

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name. The string must match exactly an identifier used to declare an enum constant in this class. (Extraneous whitespace characters are not permitted.)
items.translation: 返回此类的具有指定名称的枚举常量。该字符串必须与用于在此类中声明枚举常量的标识符完全匹配。（不允许存在多余的空白字符。）

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name.
